functions.name: GoldenCross
functions.description: 金叉信号 - 5日均线上穿10日均线

functions.name: PriceMomentum
functions.description: 价格动量 - N日涨幅百分比

functions.name: RSI14
functions.description: RSI相对强弱指标(14日) - SMA算法

functions.name: KDJ_J
functions.expression: 3 * SMA((CLOSE - LLV(LOW, 9)) / (HHV(HIGH, 9) - LLV(LOW, 9)) * 100, 3, 1) - 2 * SMA(SMA((CLOSE - LLV(LOW, 9)) / (HHV(HIGH, 9) - LLV(LOW, 9)) * 100, 3, 1), 3, 1)

functions.name: ATR14
functions.expression: MA(MAX(MAX(HIGH - LOW, ABS(HIGH - REF(CLOSE, 1))), ABS(LOW - REF(CLOSE, 1))), 14)

functions.name: DMI_PDI
functions.description: DMI指标+DI(14日) - 上升动向指标
functions.expression: SMA(IF(HIGH - REF(HIGH, 1) > REF(LOW, 1) - LOW AND HIGH - REF(HIGH, 1) > 0, HIGH - REF(HIGH, 1), 0), 14, 1) / SMA(MAX(MAX(HIGH - LOW, ABS(HIGH - REF(CLOSE, 1))), ABS(LOW - REF(CLOSE, 1))), 14, 1) * 100

functions.name: DMI_MDI
functions.description: DMI指标-DI(14日) - 下降动向指标
functions.expression: SMA(IF(REF(LOW, 1) - LOW > HIGH - REF(HIGH, 1) AND REF(LOW, 1) - LOW > 0, REF(LOW, 1) - LOW, 0), 14, 1) / SMA(MAX(MAX(HIGH - LOW, ABS(HIGH - REF(CLOSE, 1))), ABS(LOW - REF(CLOSE, 1))), 14, 1) * 100

functions.name: OBV
functions.description: 能量潮OBV - 基于成交量累计

functions.name: Trend_Strength

functions.name: Bollinger_Width

functions.name: Volatility
functions.description: 历史波动率 - 20日收益率标准差

functions.name: MA_Cross_Signal
functions.description: 均线交叉综合信号(5/10/20/60四线)
functions.expression: IF(MA(CLOSE, 5) > MA(CLOSE, 10) AND MA(CLOSE, 10) > MA(CLOSE, 20) AND MA(CLOSE, 20) > MA(CLOSE, 60), 1, IF(MA(CLOSE, 5) < MA(CLOSE, 10) AND MA(CLOSE, 10) < MA(CLOSE, 20) AND MA(CLOSE, 20) < MA(CLOSE, 60), -1, 0))

functions.name: Bottom_Divergence
functions.description: 底部信号 - 价格创新低但RSI未创新低
functions.expression: IF(CLOSE < REF(LLV(CLOSE, 20), 1) AND SMA(MAX(CLOSE - REF(CLOSE, 1), 0), 14, 1) / SMA(ABS(CLOSE - REF(CLOSE, 1)), 14, 1) * 100 > REF(SMA(MAX(CLOSE - REF(CLOSE, 1), 0), 14, 1) / SMA(ABS(CLOSE - REF(CLOSE, 1)), 14, 1) * 100, 1), 1, 0)

functions.name: Bollinger_Squeeze
functions.description: 布林带收窄信号 - 带宽低于近20日最低值
functions.expression: IF(((MA(CLOSE, 20) + STD(CLOSE, 20) * 2) - (MA(CLOSE, 20) - STD(CLOSE, 20) * 2)) / MA(CLOSE, 20) * 100 < LLV(((MA(CLOSE, 20) + STD(CLOSE, 20) * 2) - (MA(CLOSE, 20) - STD(CLOSE, 20) * 2)) / MA(CLOSE, 20) * 100, 20), 1, 0)
